method: Unedited screenshots of ordinary public-app controls in temporary isolated browser contexts. No UI text, controls or results were injected. No shared Marketplace publication occurred.
boundary: All case values and registration/authority stipulations are fictional teaching inputs. A supported proposal is not an actual booking, issued permission or completed shipment.
authorTrial: The YAML workspace trial confirms the model can be locally published through the UI. Runtime screenshots and case downloads use the exact stable SDK packages recorded in comparison-manifest.json, with the same authored model.
actions: Opened the earliest-arrival model YAML in an ordinary author workspace, inspected its rule and published an illustrative local release after the visible review acknowledgment. This trial browser-generated identity is separate from the stable SDK package identities below.
Imported both exact downloadable SDK .app.json releases into a new browser context using Published apps → Import app, workflow or case.
Opened Lowest-cost shipment review with Use app; waited for its current report; verified the preferred row; exported the actual UI case and checked its unchanged shared inputs and package hash.
Opened Earliest-arrival shipment review with Use app; waited for its current report; verified the preferred row; exported the actual UI case and checked its unchanged shared inputs and package hash.
